description: Ensure a client's cloud-browser profile has a residential proxy (attaches one when missing, no-op when healthy). BAMF platform admin only. TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan only; call again with confirm=true only after the operator approves. Optional country/region/city set the initial location. Proxy host and credentials are never returned. Reports 'not available yet' until the cloud browser engine supports it.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name.

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true applies it.

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code for the initial proxy location.

name: bamf.ensure_proxy
